mapper.select: SELECT c.club_id AS clubId, c.name, c.description, cc.name AS categoryName, c.created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club_member cm WHERE cm.club_id = c.club_id AND cm.join_status = '2') AS memberCount FROM club c LEFT JOIN club_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.category_id WHERE c.status = '2' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
